basis: Progestogen hypersensitivity typically manifests as dermatitis or urticaria; episodic bronchospasm does not establish lasting pulmonary damage.
Breast malignancy; breast has no axis. Metastatic organ involvement is not universal or defining.
PROM1-associated retinal degeneration causes severe visual loss; all supplied structural and functional abnormalities are ocular.
Cotton-dust occupational airway disease; no defining infection or autoimmune mechanism.
Pontocerebellar developmental and degenerative disease. Common dysphagia and visual impairment reflect neurologic dysfunction, without established gut or eye damage.
Inherited ANLN-associated glomerular disease with proteinuria and kidney failure; no immune mechanism established.
Congenital tricuspid valve malformation. Respiratory insufficiency and cyanosis reflect abnormal circulation; cerebral ischemia is a minority complication.
Malignancy of the ureteral orifice; ureter and bladder belong to the renal axis.
TRIM32 neuromuscular disease chiefly comprises skeletal muscular dystrophy. Retinal, renal and endocrine findings belong to the Bardet-Biedl subtype.
Syndromic arthritis 2/2, hypothyroidism 3/3 and bronchiectasis 1/1 support involvement; very small series. Cytopenias and oral lesions omitted by cap.
Marfanoid skeletal habitus and joint hypermobility define this connective tissue syndrome; common cardiac or ocular damage is not established.
Lysosomal storage with defining neurodegeneration; contractures 2/3 and hearing impairment 1/3. Mitral regurgitation 1/3 omitted by cap; small series.
WNT2B-associated congenital enteropathy causes persistent diarrhea and intestinal villous atrophy.
Benign cutaneous papular growths resembling seborrheic keratoses; no established immune-mediated disease.
Malignant astrocytic neoplasm arising in the central nervous system.
Hereditary choroidal dystrophy and atrophy are confined to the eye.
Inherited disorder of circadian sleep-wake regulation; associated depression is psychiatric and adds no organ axis.
Embryonal malignancy arising in the cerebellum; myogenic differentiation does not establish skeletal muscle involvement.
Mature T-cell lymphoma arising predominantly in intestinal mucosa; lymphoid malignancy supplies haematologic and lymphoma mechanism axes.
Umbrella calcium-deposition disorder classified under calcium metabolism disease; no single anatomical site or functional injury applies across the group.
Joint effusion defines the condition; an immune-mediated cause is not required across this umbrella.
Severe intellectual disability, epilepsy and brain malformations define the syndrome. Ocular and skeletal abnormalities are occasional, below 30%.
Type E brachydactyly and atrial septal defect are defining components of the syndrome.
Inherited platelet disorder with thrombocytopenia and bleeding; petechiae, bruising and epistaxis do not establish separate skin or airway damage.
Interpreted as severe hypersensitivity toxicity; renal worsening ~85%, hepatitis ~68% ([series summary](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK548098/)).
